about.title: About us
about.description: We make renting a car easy and safe.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: We are a local car rental company focused on well-kept cars, clear prices and personal service.

sections.title: Our promise
sections.body: You always see the full price before you book. No surprises at the counter.

sections.title: Get in touch
sections.body: If you have questions, message us on WhatsApp, send an email or call.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Answers to what customers ask most often.

items.q: What do I need to bring when I pick up the car?
items.a: A valid driving licence, a payment card in the renter's name for the deposit and your booking confirmation.
The amount is reserved on your card at pickup and released when the car is returned undamaged. For long rentals the amount is charged and refunded after return.
Yes. Mandatory third-party and collision insurance are always included. The excess is stated in the rental terms.

items.q: How many kilometres can I drive?
items.a: Each car includes a number of kilometres per day. The price for extra kilometres is shown on the car's page.
The car is handed over with a certain level of fuel or charge and must be returned with the same level.
Yes. The cancellation rules are in the rental terms and your booking confirmation.

items.q: Can the car be delivered to my address?
items.a: From some locations we can deliver the car. The price depends on the distance and is shown before you pay.

items.q: Can I return the car at another location?
items.a: Yes, between our locations. The fee is shown in the price summary before you book.

legal.draftNotice: Draft: this text must be reviewed and approved by the company before the site goes live.

terms.title: Rental terms
terms.description: The terms for renting a car from us.

sections.title: Renter and driving licence
sections.body: The renter must hold a valid driving licence. Requirements for age and how long you have held a licence are shown when booking.

sections.title: Booking and payment
sections.body: The booking is binding once payment is completed. The price covers rental, chosen extras and fees as shown when booking.

sections.title: Deposit
sections.body: A deposit is reserved on the renter's payment card at pickup. It is released when the car is returned in the same condition.

sections.title: Kilometres and fuel
sections.body: The included kilometres are shown on the car's page. Extra kilometres are charged at the stated rate. Return the car with the same fuel or charge level as at pickup.

sections.title: Insurance and excess
sections.body: The car is covered by mandatory third-party and collision insurance. In case of damage, the renter pays the excess.

sections.title: Cancellation
sections.body: Cancel via the link in your booking confirmation or in your account. Refund rules are shown when booking.

sections.title: Damage and accidents
sections.body: Report damage and accidents to us immediately. The car is inspected at pickup and return.

sections.title: Return
sections.body: Return the car at the agreed place and time. If you are later than the grace period, a fee is charged for each started hour, as stated in the agreement.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How we process your personal data.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: The car rental company is the data controller for the information you give us. You can contact us via the contact page.

sections.title: What we process
sections.body: Name, contact details, driving licence details, bookings, payments and messages to us.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: We use the data to carry out the rental agreement, meet legal requirements (such as bookkeeping) and answer your enquiries.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: Payments are handled by our payment provider. We never store your card details.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep the data as long as needed for the purpose or required by law, and delete it afterwards.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction and data portability. You can also object to the processing.

sections.title: Complaints
sections.body: You can complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency if you are unhappy with how we process your data.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie policy
cookiePolicy.description: Which cookies we use and how to change your consent.

sections.title: Necessary cookies
sections.body: Used for login, language, security and remembering your cookie choice. They cannot be turned off.

sections.title: Statistics
sections.body: Helps us understand how the site is used. Only set if you say yes.

sections.title: Marketing
sections.body: Used to measure ads. Only set if you say yes.
